d:
A robotic being composed of floating, disconnected metallic parts in a matte pearl white finish. The eyes are narrow, glowing amber slits expressing serene tranquility. The build is slender and humanoid, consisting of hovering spheres and plates without physical joints. The outfit is a simple, draped saffron yellow cloth around the waist.
SIGNATURE DETAILS: Two floating orbs orbiting the body, one gold and one blue.
BODY COLOR: pearl white
